Asset manager

What's New

POST /areas/{areaName}/cleanup

Perform git GC on specified area

GET /areas/{areaName}/cleanup-status

Check if there is active git GC running on specified area

HEAD /areas/{areaName}/cleanup-status

Check if there is active git GC running on specified area

GET /areas/{areaName}.git

Execute a git protocol command with a HTTP GET

POST /areas/{areaName}.git

Execute a git protocol command with a HTTP POST

HEAD /areas/{areaName}.git

Execute a git protocol command with a HTTP GET

GET /ping/{areaName}
Parameters:

Added: isUpgradable in query

If true, the API will respond with 200 if the area is not yet ready to process pull requests but is ready for upgrade requests

Parameters:

Added: isUpgradable in query

If true, the API will respond with 200 if the area is not yet ready to process pull requests but is ready for upgrade requests

What's New

Adds the given callbacks to the configuration specified.

Removes the given callbacks from the configuration specified

Adds the given inheritable callbacks to the configuration specified.

DELETE /v2/inheritable

Removes the given inheritable callbacks from the configuration specified and all applicable child configurations.

GET /nsi/api/search/networkConstructs
Parameters:

Added: nodeFunctions in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on NC nodeFunctions. NA results in all NetworkConstructs with no nodeFunctions. NOT query is supported. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated strings

Added: deviceVersion in query

(Optional) Device version

Added: netconfConfigChangeSubscription in query

(Optional) Netconf config change notification subscription of the network construct.

Added: namedQueryParam2 in query

namedQueryParam2 is to be used with dcnCriteriaSearchFor dcnCriteriaSearch, enter ospf area for namedQueryParam2

Added: namedQueryParam3 in query

namedQueryParam3 is to be used with dcnCriteriaSearchFor dcnCriteriaSearch, enter nc tags for namedQueryParam3

Added: namedQueryParam4 in query

namedQueryParam4 is to be used with dcnCriteriaSearchFor dcnCriteriaSearch, enter ipv4 ipAddress for namedQueryParam4

Added: searchAfter in query

Use searchAfter functionality of ES to paginate through the result instead of the offset value

Changed: networkConstructType in query

(Optional) List of Network Construct types. NA results in all NetworkConstructs with no type. NOT query is supported. The allowed networkConstructType values are: networkElement, shelf, osrpNode, manual, branchingUnit, subseaRoadm, submarineRepeater, foreignNode, aggregatedNetworkElement

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: OADMCapabilityNodes, OADMCapabilityNodesV2, networkConstructsWithSrlg, networkConstructsWithShareSrlg, l1ControlPlaneNodes, lookupNetworkConstructsByName, networkConstructsWithNativeMPLS, OADMAndTransponderCapabilitynodes, dcnCriteriaSearch, nodesWithAoBlacklisting dcnCriteriaSearch can not be used alone, at least one of namedQueryParam1, namedQueryParam2, namedQueryParam3, namedQueryParam4 must be provided with this named query

Changed: namedQueryParam1 in query

namedQueryParam1 must be provided for namedQuery: lookupNetworkConstructsByNameFor dncSearch, enter neName for namedQueryParam1

Changed: managementOwnerType in query

(Optional) NC Management Owner Type. NOT query is supported. The allowed values are Navigator MC, AIPA, Navigator MC_AIPA

Changed: metaDataFields in query

(Optional) List of meta data to be included. The allowed values are: resourceType, associationState, syncState, networkConstructType, resourceState, softwareVersion, nativeSoftwareVersion, displaySyncState, displayResourceState, displayAssociationState, tags, subnetName, associationStateQualifier, resourcePartitionInfo, equippedSlot.utilizationTotalCapacity, equippedSlot.utilizationUsedCapacity, equippedSlot.utilizationPercent, equippedPluggable.utilizationTotalCapacity, equippedPluggable.utilizationUsedCapacity, equippedPluggable.utilizationPercent, inUseByServiceSlot.utilizationTotalCapacity, inUseByServiceSlot.utilizationUsedCapacity, inUseByServiceSlot.utilizationPercent, inUseByServicePluggable.utilizationTotalCapacity, inUseByServicePluggable.utilizationUsedCapacity, inUseByServicePluggable.utilizationPercent, networkConstructName, vendor,roaDisplaySyncState, roaMcpDisplaySyncState, managementOwnerType, deviceType, deviceVersion, netconfConfigChangeSubscription, aggregatedMemberNELocation, aggregatedNetworkElementName, aggregatingParent, displayAbbResourceType

GET /nsi/api/v4/search/networkConstructs
Parameters:

Added: nodeFunctions in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on NC nodeFunctions. NA results in all NetworkConstructs with no nodeFunctions. NOT query is supported. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated strings

Added: deviceVersion in query

(Optional) Device version

Added: netconfConfigChangeSubscription in query

(Optional) Netconf config change notification subscription of the network construct.

Added: namedQueryParam2 in query

namedQueryParam2 is to be used with dcnCriteriaSearchFor dcnCriteriaSearch, enter ospf area for namedQueryParam2

Added: namedQueryParam3 in query

namedQueryParam3 is to be used with dcnCriteriaSearchFor dcnCriteriaSearch, enter nc tags for namedQueryParam3

Added: namedQueryParam4 in query

namedQueryParam4 is to be used with dcnCriteriaSearchFor dcnCriteriaSearch, enter ipv4 ipAddress for namedQueryParam4

Added: searchAfter in query

Use searchAfter functionality of ES to paginate through the result instead of the offset value

Changed: networkConstructType in query

(Optional) List of Network Construct types. NA results in all NetworkConstructs with no type. NOT query is supported. The allowed networkConstructType values are: networkElement, shelf, osrpNode, manual, branchingUnit, subseaRoadm, submarineRepeater, foreignNode, aggregatedNetworkElement

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: OADMCapabilityNodes, OADMCapabilityNodesV2, networkConstructsWithSrlg, networkConstructsWithShareSrlg, l1ControlPlaneNodes, lookupNetworkConstructsByName, networkConstructsWithNativeMPLS, OADMAndTransponderCapabilitynodes, dcnCriteriaSearch, nodesWithAoBlacklisting dcnCriteriaSearch can not be used alone, at least one of namedQueryParam1, namedQueryParam2, namedQueryParam3, namedQueryParam4 must be provided with this named query

Changed: namedQueryParam1 in query

namedQueryParam1 must be provided for namedQuery: lookupNetworkConstructsByNameFor dncSearch, enter neName for namedQueryParam1

Changed: managementOwnerType in query

(Optional) NC Management Owner Type. NOT query is supported. The allowed values are Navigator MC, AIPA, Navigator MC_AIPA

Changed: metaDataFields in query

(Optional) List of meta data to be included. The allowed values are: resourceType, associationState, syncState, networkConstructType, resourceState, softwareVersion, displaySyncState, displayResourceState, displayAssociationState, tags, subnetName, associationStateQualifier, resourcePartitionInfo, equippedSlot.utilizationTotalCapacity, equippedSlot.utilizationUsedCapacity, equippedSlot.utilizationPercent, equippedPluggable.utilizationTotalCapacity, equippedPluggable.utilizationUsedCapacity, equippedPluggable.utilizationPercent, inUseByServiceSlot.utilizationTotalCapacity, inUseByServiceSlot.utilizationUsedCapacity, inUseByServiceSlot.utilizationPercent, inUseByServicePluggable.utilizationTotalCapacity, inUseByServicePluggable.utilizationUsedCapacity, inUseByServicePluggable.utilizationPercent, networkConstructName, vendor, roaDisplaySyncState, roaMcpDisplaySyncState, managementOwnerType, deviceType, deviceVersion, netconfConfigChangeSubscription, aggregatedMemberNELocation, aggregatedNetworkElementName, aggregatingParent, displayAbbResourceType

GET /nsi/api/search/fres
Parameters:

Added: supportedUserLabel in query

Supported User Label. NOT query is supported.

Added: engineeredBFDReturnPath in query

Allow filtering support on SRTE EngineeredBFDReturnPath

Added: cpReverseBindingSid in query

Allow filtering support on SRTE Candidate path Reverse BindingSid

Added: headEndNetworkConstructId in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on FREs , returns Fres that have headEnd with given NcId. NOT query is supported.

Added: destIp in query

(Optional) Search for an exact match on destination IP. NA results in all Fres with no destination IP. NOT query is supported.

Added: lqsData.margin.upgrRate in query

(Optional) The LQS margin UPGR Rate. NA results in all Fres with no lqsMarginUpgrRate. NOT query is supported.

Added: fresByNodeNameAndInterfaceIP in query

(Optional) Find IP Links by (nodeName&interfaceIP) combination values separated by comma. NOT query is supported.

Added: ccmAdminState in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on FRE on ccmAdminState

Added: displayData.displayPhotonicSpectrumData.transMode in query

(Optional) Allow filter by transMode

Added: freBysourceEndDestEndBsid in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (sourceEnd&DestinationEnd&Bsid) values separated by comma. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: freBysourceEndDestEndColor in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (sourceEnd&DestinationEnd&Color) values separated by comma. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: isDeviceAutocreated in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (isDeviceAutocreated) values true or false. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: isNNCSIntentOwner in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (isNNCSIntentOwner) values true or false. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: currentPathStatus in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (currentPathStatus) values onPrimaryPath or onBestNonPrimaryPath or offBestAvailablePath or down or NA. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: offPrimaryPath in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (offPrimaryPath) values Yes or No or NA. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: aipaSourceRouterId in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by aipaSourceRouterId

Added: searchAfter in query

Use searchAfter functionality of ES to paginate through the result instead of the offset value

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated list. NA results in all Fres with no layerRate. NOT query is supported. The allowed layerRate values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E3_34M, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, DSR_34M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, LINE_OC12_STS12_AND_MS_STM4, SECTION_OC12_STS12_AND_RS_STM4, LINE_OC48_STS48_AND_MS_STM16, SECTION_OC48_STS48_AND_RS_STM16, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, STS192C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, FLEXE_GROUP, IP, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, XGTC, STS1_50M, DSR_50M, VC4C, VC4_4C, VC4_16C, Flex, PPP, GCC

Changed: pcepManagementType in query

(Optional) Filter SR Policies FRE with pcepManagementType. Possible values ["NA", "PCE-Initiated", "PCC-Delegated"]

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. NA results in all Fres with no serviceClass. NOT query is supported. LLDP, ROADM Line and Fiber has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, DSR Ethernet, LAG, OTU, OMS, OTS, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, PON Link, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical, PROTECTED_OMS, ODU Tunnel, PPP, Flow

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: resiliency, tdmServices, topologicalLinks, roadmLineSpan, reusableSNCG, reusableMRSNCG, reusableNMRSNCG, tunnelReplacement, layer1OtuLinks, photonicSncpWorkLegs, relatedFresFull, relatedFresLight, ringsWithoutConstraints, groupedSNCDTLSET, relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent,relatedShelfRoadmlineForIntent, fresWithSrlg, l1LinkFresForHomeRoute, l1NcpTransportServices, resiliencyFre,staticRouteL3VPN, l1NcpLinkFres, virtualRingsOnL2Motr, fresWithSupportedPWModes, ebgpL3VPN, layer1LinkConstraints, physicalLinkFres, fresWithTimeAwareSrlg, fresByNcPairs, supportedProtectionFres, virtualOSRPLinkFres, baseOSRPLinkFre

tunnelReplacement cannot be used in combination with other named queries

virtualRingsOnL2Motr can not be used alone, networkConstruct.Id must be provided with this named query

fresWithSupportedPWModes can be combined with namedQueryParam1 or namedQueryParam2 or both

photonicSncpWorkLegs can not be used alone, networkConstruct.Id must be provided with this named query

relatedFresFull can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedFresLight can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

l1LinkFresForHomeRoute can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

resiliencyFre can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

groupedSNCDTLSET cannot be used in combination with other named queries and can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

staticRouteL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

l1NcpLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

ebgpL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

physicalLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

fresByNcPairs can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {neName1&neName2},{neName3&neName4}...

supportedProtectionFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

virtualOSRPLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

baseOSRPLinkFre can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

relatedShelfRoadmlineForIntent can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

Changed: namedQueryParam1 in query

Mandatory when namedQuery relatedFresFull/relatedFresLight/relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent/l1LinkFresForHomeRoute/resiliencyFre/l1NcpLinkFres/physicalLinkFres/supportedProtectionFres/virtualOSRPLinkFres/baseOSRPLinkFre is used.

Changed: metaDataFields in query

MetaData to be included. Use prefix SUM_ to get sum of metadata field. Use syntax metadata1::metadata2 to get metadata2 of metadata1(subAggregation). The allowed values are: layerRate, layerRateQualifier, signalContentType, serviceClass, sncgUserlabel, adminState, operationState, lqsData.status, lqsData.margin.valid, lqsData.fiber.reconciled, GET /nsi/api/v1/search/fres
Parameters:

Added: lqsData.margin.upgrRate in query

(Optional) The LQS margin UPGR Rate.

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated list The allowed values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E3_34M, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, DSR_34M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, Flex, PPP, GCC

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. LLDP has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, LAG, OTU, ROADM Line, OMS, Fiber, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical, PPP, Flow

Changed: metaDataFields in query

MetaData to be included. The allowed values are: layerRate, layerRateQualifier, signalContentType, serviceClass, sncgUserlabel, adminState, operationState, lqsData.status, lqsData.margin.valid, lqsData.fiber.reconciled, lqsData.fiber.method, lqsData.margin.viableAtEol, lqsData.margin.upgrRate, displayAdminState, displayOperationState, displayTopologySource, customerName, domainTypes, resilienceLevel, directionality

GET /nsi/api/v2/search/fres
Parameters:

Added: lqsData.margin.upgrRate in query

(Optional) The LQS margin UPGR Rate. NA results in all Fres with no lqsMarginUpgrRate. NOT query is supported.

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated. NA results in all Fres with no layerRate. NOT query is supported. list. The allowed layerRate values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E3_34M, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, DSR_34M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, LINE_OC12_STS12_AND_MS_STM4, SECTION_OC12_STS12_AND_RS_STM4, LINE_OC48_STS48_AND_MS_STM16, SECTION_OC48_STS48_AND_RS_STM16, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, STS192C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, FLEXE_GROUP, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, XGTC, STS1_50M, DSR_50M, VC4C, VC4_4C, VC4_16C, Flex, PPP, GCC

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. NA results in all Fres with no serviceClass. NOT query is supported. LLDP has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, DSR Ethernet, LAG, OTU, ROADM Line, OMS, Fiber, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, PON Link, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical, PROTECTED_OMS, ODU Tunnel, PPP, Flow

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: resiliency, tdmServices, topologicalLinks, roadmLineSpan, reusableSNCG, reusableMRSNCG, reusableNMRSNCG, tunnelReplacement, layer1OtuLinks, photonicSncpWorkLegs, relatedFresFull, relatedFresLight, ringsWithoutConstraints, groupedSNCDTLSET, relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent, relatedShelfRoadmlineForIntent, fresWithSrlg, l1LinkFresForHomeRoute, l1NcpTransportServices, resiliencyFre, fresLookupByName,staticRouteL3VPN, l1NcpLinkFres,eviId,rtList, ebgpL3VPN, layer1LinkConstraints, physicalLinkFres, fresWithSupportedPWModes, fresWithTimeAwareSrlg, supportedProtectionFres

tunnelReplacement cannot be used in combination with other named queries

fresWithSupportedPWModes can be combined with namedQueryParam1 or namedQueryParam2 or both

photonicSncpWorkLegs can not be used alone, networkConstruct.Id must be provided with this named query

relatedFresFull can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedFresLight can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

l1LinkFresForHomeRoute can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

resiliencyFre can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

groupedSNCDTLSET cannot be used in combination with other named queries and can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

fresLookupByName can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

staticRouteL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

l1NcpLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

eviId can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

cfmAdminState can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

rtList can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

ebgpL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

physicalLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

supportedProtectionFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

relatedShelfRoadmlineForIntent can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

Changed: namedQueryParam1 in query

Mandatory when namedQuery relatedFresFull/relatedFresLight/relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent/relatedShelfRoadmlineForIntent/l1LinkFresForHomeRoute/resiliencyFre/l1NcpLinkFres/physicalLinkFres/supportedProtectionFres is used.

Changed: metaDataFields in query

MetaData to be included. The allowed values are: layerRate, layerRateQualifier, signalContentType, serviceClass, sncgUserlabel, adminState, operationState, lqsData.status, lqsData.margin.valid, lqsData.fiber.reconciled, lqsData.fiber.method, lqsData.margin.viableAtEol, lqsData.margin.upgrRate, displayAdminState, displayOperationState, displayTopologySource, customerName, domainTypes, resilienceLevel, directionality, displayDeploymentState, ringType, ringCompleteness, displayRecoveryCharacteristicsOnHome, lqsData.ppg.snrStatus, internalStructure, lqsData.ppg.categorySnrReference, lqsData.ppg.deltaSnrReference, totalCapacity, usedCapacity, utilizationPercent, capacityUnits, restorationHealth.totalExplicitRoutes, restorationHealth.availableExplicitRoutes, restorationHealth.unavailableExplicitRoutes, restorationHealth.availablePercentage, restorationHealth.unavailablePercentage, restorationHealth.homeAvailable, remoteOSRPNodeName, headOSRPNodeName, isDTLSetUsedAsRoutingConstraint, importRouteTargets, exportRouteTargets, relatedServices, signalingType, sourceEndPoint, destEndPoint, bindingAllocatedSid, profileName, bandwidthOverSubscribed, transportPolicy, catalog, srColor, fallback, nVid, cfmAdminState, color, dailyThroughput.averageUtilization, dailyThroughput.maxUtilization, dailyThroughput.ninetyFifthUtilization, weeklyThroughput.averageUtilization, weeklyThroughput.maxUtilization, weeklyThroughput.ninetyFifthUtilization, remoteOSRPNodeName, headOSRPNodeName, isDTLSetUsedAsRoutingConstraint, importRouteTargets, exportRouteTargets, destinationPrefix, selectedRoute, vrfName, vrfId, nextHopIp, relatedServices, isOtdrCapable, sourceTraceType, sourceTraceTimestamp, destinationTraceType, destinationTraceTimestamp, sourceOtdrcfgaId, sourceNcId, destinationOtdrcfgaId, destinationNcId, displayServerRefreshState, nativeName, isSubmarineLink, trafficType, igpProtocols, ospf.area, extendedFreId, bandPeerFreIds

GET /nsi/api/v5/search/fres
Parameters:

Added: supportedUserLabel in query

Supported User Label. NOT query is supported.

Added: engineeredBFDReturnPath in query

Allow filtering support on SRTE EngineeredBFDReturnPath

Added: cpReverseBindingSid in query

Allow filtering support on SRTE Candidate path Reverse BindingSid

Added: headEndNetworkConstructId in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on FREs , returns Fres that have headEnd with given NcId. NOT query is supported.

Added: destIp in query

(Optional) Search for an exact match on destination IP. NA results in all Fres with no destination IP. NOT query is supported.

Added: lqsData.margin.upgrRate in query

(Optional) The LQS margin UPGR Rate. NA results in all Fres with no lqsMarginUpgrRate. NOT query is supported.

Added: fresByNodeNameAndInterfaceIP in query

(Optional) Find IP Links by (nodeName&interfaceIP) combination values separated by comma. NOT query is supported.

Added: ccmAdminState in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on FRE on ccmAdminState

Added: displayData.displayPhotonicSpectrumData.transMode in query

(Optional) transMode

Added: freBysourceEndDestEndBsid in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (sourceEnd&DestinationEnd&Bsid) values separated by comma. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: freBysourceEndDestEndColor in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (sourceEnd&DestinationEnd&Color) values separated by comma. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: isDeviceAutocreated in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (isDeviceAutocreated) values true or false. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: isNNCSIntentOwner in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (isNNCSIntentOwner) values true or false. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: currentPathStatus in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (currentPathStatus) values onPrimaryPath or onBestNonPrimaryPath or offBestAvailablePath or down or NA. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: offPrimaryPath in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by (offPrimaryPath) values Yes or No or NA. NA results in all Fres with no sr Te Policy. NOT query is supported.

Added: aipaSourceRouterId in query

(Optional) Find SR TE POLICY by aipaSourceRouterId

Added: searchAfter in query

Use searchAfter functionality of ES to paginate through the result instead of the offset value

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated. NA results in all Fres with no layerRate. NOT query is supported. list. The allowed layerRate values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E3_34M, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, DSR_34M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, STS192C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, FLEXE_GROUP, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, PON, STS1_50M, DSR_50M, Flex, PPP, GCC

Changed: pcepManagementType in query

(Optional) Filter SR Policies FRE with pcepManagementType. Possible values ["NA", "PCE-Initiated", "PCC-Delegated"]

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. NA results in all Fres with no serviceClass. NOT query is supported. LLDP , Fiber and ROADM Line has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, DSR Ethernet, LAG, OTU, OMS, OTS, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, PON Link, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical, PROTECTED_OMS, ODU Tunnel, PPP, Flow

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: resiliency, tdmServices, topologicalLinks, roadmLineSpan, reusableSNCG, reusableMRSNCG, reusableNMRSNCG, tunnelReplacement, layer1OtuLinks, photonicSncpWorkLegs, relatedFresFull, relatedFresLight, ringsWithoutConstraints, groupedSNCDTLSET, relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent, relatedShelfRoadmlineForIntent, fresWithSrlg, l1LinkFresForHomeRoute, l1NcpTransportServices, resiliencyFre, fresLookupByName,staticRouteL3VPN, l1NcpLinkFres,eviId,rtList, layer1LinkConstraints, physicalLinkFres, fresWithSupportedPWModes, fresWithTimeAwareSrlg, supportedProtectionFres, virtualOSRPLinkFres, baseOSRPLinkFre

tunnelReplacement cannot be used in combination with other named queries

fresWithSupportedPWModes can be combined with namedQueryParam1 or namedQueryParam2 or both

photonicSncpWorkLegs can not be used alone, networkConstruct.Id must be provided with this named query

relatedFresFull can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedFresLight can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

l1LinkFresForHomeRoute can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

resiliencyFre can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

groupedSNCDTLSET cannot be used in combination with other named queries and can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

fresLookupByName can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

staticRouteL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

l1NcpLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

eviId can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

cfmAdminState can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

rtList can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

physicalLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

fresByNcPairs can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {neName1&neName2},{neName3&neName4}...

supportedProtectionFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

virtualOSRPLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

baseOSRPLinkFre can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

relatedShelfRoadmlineForIntent can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

Changed: namedQueryParam1 in query

Mandatory when namedQuery relatedFresFull/relatedFresLight/relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent/relatedShelfRoadmlineForIntent/l1LinkFresForHomeRoute/resiliencyFre/l1NcpLinkFres/physicalLinkFres/supportedProtectionFres/virtualOSRPLinkFres/baseOSRPLinkFre is used.

Changed: metaDataFields in query

MetaData to be included. Use prefix SUM_ to get sum of metadata field. Use syntax metadata1::metadata2 to get metadata2 of metadata1(subAggregation). GET /nsi/api/v9/fres
Parameters:

Changed: layerRate in query

(Optional) FRE layer rates in comma separated list. Only applied when Network Construct identifier is provided. The allowed values are: ETHERNET, OTU2, OTU4, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, ODU2, ODU4, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, STS1_50M, DSR_50M, STS3C, STS12C, STS48C, VC4, VC4C, VC4_4C, VC4_16C, Flex, PPP, GCC

Return Type:

Changed response : 200 OK

Successfully retrieved the list of FREs.

GET /tdc/api/v1/diag/pms/prfbers
Parameters:

Changed: resetIdf in query

(Optional) Test Pre-FEC BER with reset untimed IDF (default false). If reset, Navigator MC will reset untimed IDF 15 Secs after service channel becomes DOC managed, wait for another 15 sec and then retrieve pre-FEC BER data from untimed bin for the test;Otherwise, Navigator MC will retrieve pre-FEC BER data from untimed bin directly for the test
